rlUInt8_t vco2RangeConfig
 VCO2 frequency range configuration
Bit Definition
b0 VCO2 frequency range selection
VCO2 in xWR294x/xWR254x/xWR2x4xECO/xWR2x4xP only supports a maximum bandwidth of 4.5GHz.
The user can select between the two allowed ranges shown below:
1 - VCO2 range is 76GHz - 80.5GHz
0 - VCO2 range is 76.5GHz - 81GHz
Default setting: 0 (76.5-81GHz)
b7:1 RESERVED

rlUInt16_t rlRfTxFreqPwrLimitMonConf_t::freqLimitHighTx0

The sensor's higher frequency limit for calibrations and monitoring for TX0 is
encoded in 2 bytes (16 bit unsigned number)
1 LSB = 10 MHz
For 77GHz devices(76GHz to 81GHz)
Valid range: 7600 to 8100 Default value : 8100 (If API is not issued) For 60GHz devices(57GHz to 64GHz)
Valid range: 5700 to 6400 Default value : 6400 (If API is not issued) For xWR294x/xWR254x/xWR2x4xECO/xWR2x4xP devices
Valid range: 7620 to 8050/8100 (based on VCO2_RANGE_CONFIG in this API) Default value : 8050 (If this API is not issued)

Note
: FREQ_LIMIT_HIGH_TXn should be strictly greater than FREQ_LIMIT_LOW_TXn
